verdict.rationale: Shortwave is a SaaS email client, so publishing a machine-readable API spec is a fair ask and the axis applies. The evidence documents no public API or spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Its MCP support is client-side (connecting its AI to other servers) and is not an API spec for Shortwave itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
